bio.text: Joseph Addabbo is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 15, an office assumed in 2009, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as the Democratic candidate for re-election.
Ballotpedia says Addabbo earned a bachelor's degree from Saint John's University in 1986 and a J.D. from Touro Law School.
Professional experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working as an attorney and serving on the New York City Council.
